name: AWS Rekognition
label: Amazon Rekognition — labels, faces, text
description: Official Amazon Rekognition Image JSON 1.1 API. POST https://rekognition.{region}.amazonaws.com/ signed with AWS SigV4 (service rekognition). Content-Type application/x-amz-json-1.1 and X-Amz-Target RekognitionService.{Action} are set per operation. operation: detect_labels, detect_faces, detect_text, compare_faces. Prefer Image / SourceImage / TargetImage S3Object; never inline bytes in graph JSON. Face/biometric ops require a customer DPIA; no covert surveillance. Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation Rekognition JSON. Prefer Image / SourceImage / TargetImage as official {S3Object:{Bucket,Name}} objects. Never put AWS keys here. Example: {"Image":{"S3Object":{"Bucket":"my-bucket","Name":"photo.jpg"}}}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: detect_labels | detect_faces | detect_text | compare_faces.

schema.label: Image
schema.description: Official Image object: {Bytes} (base64, not stored in graph) or {S3Object:{Bucket,Name,Version?}}. Use S3Object when the object is already in the customer AWS account.

schema.label: MaxLabels
schema.description: DetectLabels MaxLabels (0–1000). Omit to use the API default.

schema.label: MinConfidence
schema.description: DetectLabels MinConfidence 0–100. API default 55 if omitted.

schema.label: Attributes
schema.description: DetectFaces Attributes. EXACT tokens: DEFAULT | ALL | AGE_RANGE | BEARD | EMOTIONS | EYE_DIRECTION | EYEGLASSES | EYES_OPEN | GENDER | MOUTH_OPEN | MUSTACHE | FACE_OCCLUDED | SMILE | SUNGLASSES.

schema.label: SimilarityThreshold
schema.description: CompareFaces SimilarityThreshold 0–100. Faces below this score are unmatched.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Rekognition JSON). Face geometry/landmarks are biometric data — minimize retention downstream. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default Rekognition action. EXACT: detect_labels | detect_faces | detect_text | compare_faces. Maps to X-Amz-Target RekognitionService.{Action}.

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.
